A headerless table whose rows have different cell counts is padded, not turned into a list

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><td>A</td><td>B</td></tr><tr><td>C</td></tr></table>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
